data.name: Asita
data.gender_notes: Asita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who sees or knows the future. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘as’ meaning ‘to see’ and ‘ita’ meaning ‘that’. In Hindu mythology, Asita is the name of a sage who could foresee the future. The name Asita carries the meaning “Seer of the Future” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asita usually hope their child will grow to embody seer of the future and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with the gift of divine foresight.
data.etymology: Asita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Seer of the Future.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asita total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_sanskrit.name: असित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Asita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asita' which means 'dawn' or 'beginning of day'. It is a significant name in Hindu mythology as it is used to refer to a sage named Asita who was present during the Samudra Manthana or the churning of the ocean by the gods and demons.

in_hindi.name: असित
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Asita can be translated to 'Shubhraatri' or 'Prakritika'. Shubhraatri means 'auspicious' or 'fortunate' and Prakritika means 'natural' or 'basic'. These translations further emphasize the significance of the name Asita which means 'dawn' or 'beginning of day'.

in_tamil.name: ஆசிதா
